'''2011 Belgium Regionals Jerome Nitschke DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jerome Nitschke]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jérôme Nitschke
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
